quotations.old_english: Mid ðý he ðá geswippre múþe líccetende ǽrend rehte [MS. wrehte] and leáse fleswede
quotations.latin: cum sĭmŭlātam lēgātiōnem ōre astūto volvĕret
quotations.english: when he then told a feigned message with his crafty mouth, and falsely whispered

source_text: fleswian; p. ede; pp. ed To mutter, whisper; susurr&a-long;re :-- Mid ðý he ðá geswippre múþe líccetende ǽrend rehte [MS. wrehte] and leáse fleswede when he then told a feigned message with his crafty mouth, and falsely whispered; cum s&i-short;m&u-short;l&a-long;tam l&e-long;g&a-long;ti&o-long;nem &o-long;re ast&u-long;to volv&e-short;ret, Bd. 2, 9; S. 511, 20.
